protocol.scope: six calibration scans only; no holdouts, reception, or search
protocol.iteration: full visible catalogue reselected using training-only shared robust_core shortlist/CFO; reserve mixture fit via fit_frequency.fit
protocol.convergence: both parameter relative changes <1% and MAP IDs >=99% unchanged after reselection at updated parameters; max5 rounds; final refit must also pass
protocol.interpretation: approximate conditional fixed point, not a global MLE; no LOSO claim
